messages:
sam_k: Heads up — noticed usage dashboards for several tenants are showing last datapoint ~3.5h behind (hour buckets stuck at 14:00). Affects console charts and billing previews. Anyone else seeing this?

maria_s: yup saw same, customer flagged it. No deploys from our side in the window. Quick check: hourly_rollup max(ts)=2024-09-12T14:00Z for some tenants.

raj_p: checking Kafka consumer groups + CDC offsets now. consumer 'usage-processor' reports 0 lag but low throughput. posting quick describe output.

ingest-bot: ```
$ kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group usage-processor
TOPIC          PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
usage.events   0          123456          123456          0
usage.events   1          123400          123400          0
...
```

maria_s: 0 lag but series old — maybe writes succeeded earlier but rollups/backfill stalled. Any errors in ETL workers?

raj_p: digging into etl-worker logs. I see repeated 5xx errors hitting S3 during 11:40–12:20 (throttling). Snippet: 
```
2024-09-12T11:45:03Z ERROR s3 upload failed 503 slow-down
2024-09-12T11:46:12Z WARN retrying chunk upload
2024-09-12T11:46:40Z ERROR failed to flush rollup batch after retries
```

sam_k: sounds like S3 throttling slowed the hourly-rehydrate job and created a backlog -> dashboards stale. Can we prioritize impacted tenants?

ops_oncall: bumping priority. I'll increase parallelism for the hourly-rehydrate workers to 8 and pause lower-priority batch jobs for 30m. Monitoring now.

maria_s: I've emailed affected customers with an ETA ~1.5h for catch-up and posted a short status note in the console: "analytics delay — backlog replay in progress :hourglass_flowing_sand:"

raj_p: kicked manual replays for the highest-impact tenants (ids redacted). command used: 
```
./bin/rehydrate --tenant acme --start 2024-09-12T10:00Z --end 2024-09-12T14:00Z --priority high
```

ingest-bot: backfill job progress: 20% -> 70% over 25m. Estimated time to catch up ~35m.

sam_k: customer acknowledges, thanks. Will keep thread open until dashboards show current hour. :thumbsup:

ops_oncall: catch-up completed — hourly_rollup max(ts) now 2024-09-12T15:05Z for previously impacted tenants. Dashboard charts refreshed. Marking incident resolved.

maria_s: filing follow-up ticket to add alerting when rollup max(ts) lags >1h while consumer lag=0 (false negative for consumer-lag-only alerts).

raj_p: putting a short note in the postmortem: root cause S3 slow-down -> backfill throttled; mitigation: increase exponential backoff and add prioritized replay queue for critical tenants.

sam_k: great — closing thread. /cc eng-sre for follow-up.
